d: The role of the Cashier is to efficiently handle sales transactions while providing excellent customer service. The Cashier will also support operational duties assigned by the store management team, such as maintaining visual presentation standards, driving impulse buying at the counter, and promoting the loyalty program.
q: Candidates should have 1-2 years of experience in a cashier or customer service role, demonstrating proficiency in point-of-sale systems, accurate cash handling, and basic math skills. Additionally, strong communication skills and attention to detail are essential for success in this position.
